# HandyToolkit - Knowledge Base

> Free browser-based tools for developers and everyday work, in Korean. Everything runs locally in the browser.

## Tools (8)
- JSON formatter and validator: checks syntax and pretty-prints JSON.
- Base64 encoder/decoder: text to Base64 and back.
- JWT decoder: shows header and payload claims (exp, iat, aud, iss); it does not verify signatures.
- QR code generator: text, URL, Wi-Fi, email, phone to PNG or SVG.
- Password generator: random passwords with chosen length and character classes.
- UUID generator: v4 (random), v7 (time-ordered) and nil UUIDs.
- Hash generator: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512.
- Color converter: HEX, RGB, HSL.

## Language
Korean only (https://handytoolkit.online/ko).

## Privacy
Tool inputs and outputs are not sent to or stored by the site. Analytics (Google Analytics), third-party advertising (Adsterra) and affiliate links are used on the site and disclosed at https://handytoolkit.online/ko/privacy.

## Citation
Cite as "HandyToolkit (handytoolkit.online)" with the specific tool page URL.
